about: Every user-facing string of the shared Save / Open / Export / Recovery layer. Edit simple/shared/electron/io-catalog.json, then copy it byte for byte to simple/shared/renderer/io-catalog.json. Placeholders are written {name}. Prompts list their buttons in display order; defaultId and cancelId are button ids.

placeholders.name: this file
placeholders.reason: Something went wrong while creating the file.

notices.CANCELED: Saving "{name}" was canceled. Nothing was changed.
notices.BLOCKED: Apply or close the open dialog first, then save again.
notices.OPEN_IN_ANOTHER_WINDOW: "{name}" is open in another Simple window. Close it there first, or save your changes with a different name.
notices.NOT_A_FILE: "{name}" is a folder, not a file.

OPEN_IN_ANOTHER_WINDOW.message: "{name}" is open in another Simple window.
OPEN_IN_ANOTHER_WINDOW.detail: Close it there, then choose Try Again. Or save your changes with the same name in another folder.

LOCKED.detail: Close it there, then choose Try Again. Or save your changes with the same name in another folder.

READ_ONLY.detail: Save your changes with the same name in another folder, or with a new name.

NO_PERMISSION.message: Simple doesn't have permission to save "{name}" in "{folder}".
NO_PERMISSION.detail: Save your changes with the same name in another folder.

READ_ONLY_VOLUME.message: Simple can't save on {drive} because it can't be written to.
READ_ONLY_VOLUME.detail: It may be write-protected. Save your changes on another drive.

FOLDER_MISSING.detail: It may have been moved, renamed or disconnected. Save your changes in another folder.

FILE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: Another program may be using this file, or its drive or network folder may be unavailable. Try again in a moment, or save your changes in another folder.

DISK_FULL.message: There isn't enough space on {drive} to save "{name}".
DISK_FULL.detail: Free up at least {needed}, or save to another drive.

NAME_TOO_LONG.message: The file name or folder path is too long.
NAME_TOO_LONG.detail: Choose a shorter name or a folder closer to the top of the drive.

INVALID_NAME.message: "{name}" can't be used as a file name here.
INVALID_NAME.detail: Choose a different name. A file name can't end with a space or a period, can't be the name of a folder that is already there, and can't contain these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |

CHANGED_ON_DISK.message: "{name}" was changed by another program after you opened it.
CHANGED_ON_DISK.detail: Saving now replaces those changes with yours. To keep both, save your version as a new file.

SOURCE_MISSING.message: "{name}" was moved, renamed or deleted after you opened it.
SOURCE_MISSING.detail: Save it again in its original folder, or choose where to save it.

VERIFY_FAILED.message: Simple couldn't confirm that "{name}" was saved correctly, so the original file was kept.
VERIFY_FAILED.detail: Your changes are still open. Try again. If this keeps happening, save to another folder.

VALIDATION_FAILED.message: Simple didn't save "{name}" because the new file failed its safety check. Your original file wasn't changed.
VALIDATION_FAILED.detail: Your changes are still open. Try again, or save them with Save As in another format.

NEEDS_OFFICE_ENGINE.message: Simple can't save {formatLabel} files on this PC.
NEEDS_OFFICE_ENGINE.detail: Save your changes as {altLabel} instead. "{name}" stays unchanged.

RESTORE_NEEDED.message: Saving "{name}" stopped partway, and the original couldn't be put back automatically.
RESTORE_NEEDED.detail: The original is safe at "{backupPath}". Your changes are still open, so save them with Save As now.

UNKNOWN.detail: Your changes are still open. Try again, or save them in another folder.

DAMAGED.message: Simple couldn't open "{name}" because the file is damaged or incomplete.
DAMAGED.detail: If someone sent it to you, ask them to send it again.

ENCRYPTED.detail: Simple can't open password-protected {formatLabel} files yet.

TOO_LARGE.message: "{name}" is larger than {limit}, the most Simple can open.

NEEDS_OFFICE_ENGINE.message: Simple can't open {formatLabel} files on this PC.
NEEDS_OFFICE_ENGINE.detail: Save the file in another format in the program that made it, then open that copy.

NOT_FOUND.detail: It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.

FOLDER_MISSING.detail: It may have been moved, renamed or disconnected.

LOCKED.message: Another program is blocking "{name}" from being read.
LOCKED.detail: Close it there, then try again.

FILE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: Another program may be using this file, or its drive or network folder may be unavailable. Try again in a moment.

NO_PERMISSION.message: Simple doesn't have permission to open "{name}".
NO_PERMISSION.detail: Copy it to a folder you can use, such as Documents, and open the copy.

NAME_TOO_LONG.message: The file name or folder path of "{name}" is too long to open.
NAME_TOO_LONG.detail: Move it to a folder closer to the top of the drive, or give it a shorter name.

UNKNOWN.detail: Try again. If this keeps happening, copy the file to another folder and open the copy.

unsaved.message: Do you want to save the changes to "{name}"?
unsaved.detail: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.

unsaved-untitled.message: Do you want to save this new {kind}?
unsaved-untitled.detail: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.

lossy-save.detail: {formatLabel} keeps only {keeps}. These will be lost: {lostList}. To keep everything, save as {fullLabel}.

lossy-close.message: "{name}" was saved as {formatLabel}, which doesn't keep {lostShort}.
lossy-close.detail: Save a full copy as {fullLabel} before closing?

sibling-save.detail: Simple can't update {formatLabel} files, so your changes go into a new file in the same folder. "{name}" stays unchanged.

replace-existing.message: "{finalName}" already exists. Do you want to replace it?

encoding-lossy.detail: Save as UTF-8 instead to keep every character.

not-responding.detail: Wait for it, or close the window. Changes up to {lastAutosave} will be offered the next time you open {appName}.

crashed.detail: Your work up to {lastAutosave} was kept.

status.willSaveAgain: Will save again when the current save finishes
status.autosaveOff: Autosave is off for this very large file. Save often.

toast.savedNewerPending: Saved. Newer changes aren't saved yet.
toast.savedModernCopy: Saved your changes as "{siblingName}" next to the original, because Simple can't update {formatLabel} files. "{name}" wasn't changed.
toast.exportCanceled: Export canceled. No file was created.
toast.pasteOneFile: Paste one file at a time, or drag them in.
toast.shownInFolder: "{name}" is shown in its folder, because Simple can't open this kind of file.

recovery.changedSince: The file has changed since then. Saving will ask before replacing it.
recovery.sourceMissing: The original file isn't there anymore. Saving will ask where to save it.
recovery.cannotRestore: This copy depends on the original file, which has changed or is missing, so it can't be restored.
recovery.banner: You have unsaved changes to this file from {time}.
recovery.restoreOpensNewWindow: Your newer edits stay here, and the recovered changes open in a new window.
recovery.crashScreen: Simple ran into a problem. Your work up to {time} is safe.

engine.docOpenedAsText: Opened as text only. Simple can't read the formatting of this older Word file, so your edits will be saved as "{stem}.docx" next to the original.
engine.legacySheet: Older spreadsheet format. Your edits will be saved as "{stem}.xlsx" next to the original, because Simple can't update {formatLabel} files.
engine.presentationNotSupported: Simple can't turn PowerPoint files into PDFs on this PC.
engine.basicFormatting: This file was opened with basic formatting. Some layout details may look different.
engine.statusFound: Older Office files open with full formatting, using LibreOffice found on this PC ({path}).
engine.statusNotFound: Older Office and OpenDocument files open with basic formatting, and edits are saved as .docx or .xlsx next to the original.

versions.title: Earlier versions of "{name}"
versions.intro: Before Simple first replaces a file in a session, it keeps a copy of the file as it was. Open one as a copy to compare it or take things back.
versions.empty: There are no earlier versions of "{name}" yet.
versions.unavailable: Simple can't open this earlier version. It may have been removed.
